e.title: Explainable AI in Fraud Detection
e.summary: 金融欺诈可解释 AI 全流水线（800★）：GNN+梯度提升+自编码器，SHAP/GNNExplainer 解释+PSI 漂移
e.body: Explainable-AI-in-Financial-Fraud-and-Anomaly-Detection（jiyuanwang-afk，800★）实现可解释欺诈/异常检测混合流水线：交易图上的图神经网络（GNN）+ 表格梯度提升（基线）+ 自编码器无监督异常评分，事后可解释性用 SHAP/置换重要性/GNNExplainer 式节点边重要性，另含总体稳定性指数（PSI）漂移追踪与 F1/PR-AUC 阈值优化，带可配置训练 CLI 与单元测试。对 RIAA：反欺诈与异常检测的可解释建模学习——与 [[networkfraud]]（保险欺诈网络分析）、[[aws-fraud-graph]]（AWS 图检测样例）、[[fraud-detection]]（概念）配套；可解释性方法与 [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] 同属可信 AI 方向。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：GNN+GBDT+AE 混合可解释欺诈流水线（SHAP/PSI/阈值优化），800★
e.summary_en: Explainable AI pipeline for financial fraud/anomaly detection (800★): GNN + gradient boosting + autoencoder, SHAP/GNNExplainer explanations + PSI drift
e.summary_hk: 金融欺詐可解釋 AI 全流水線（800★）：GNN+梯度提升+自編碼器，SHAP/GNNExplainer 解釋+PSI 漂移
e.body_en: Explainable-AI-in-Financial-Fraud-and-Anomaly-Detection (jiyuanwang-afk, 800★) implements a hybrid explainable fraud/anomaly-detection pipeline: GNNs over a transaction graph, tabular gradient boosting (baseline) for calibrated probabilities, autoencoders for unsupervised anomaly scoring, post-hoc explainability via SHAP / permutation importance / GNNExplainer-style node-and-edge importance, plus population stability index (PSI) drift tracking and F1/PR-AUC threshold optimisation, with a configurable training CLI and unit tests. For RIAA: learning explainable modelling for fraud and anomaly detection — pairs with [[networkfraud]] (insurance fraud network analysis), [[aws-fraud-graph]] (AWS graph-detection sample) and [[fraud-detection]] (the concept); explainability methods align with [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] in the trustworthy-AI direction.
e.body_hk: Explainable-AI-in-Financial-Fraud-and-Anomaly-Detection（jiyuanwang-afk，800★）實現可解釋欺詐/異常檢測混合流水線：交易圖上的圖神經網絡（GNN）+ 表格梯度提升（基線）+ 自編碼器無監督異常評分，事後可解釋性用 SHAP/置換重要性/GNNExplainer 式節點邊重要性，另含總體穩定性指數（PSI）漂移追蹤與 F1/PR-AUC 閾值優化，帶可配置訓練 CLI 與單元測試。對 RIAA：反欺詐與異常檢測的可解釋建模學習——與 [[networkfraud]]（保險欺詐網絡分析）、[[aws-fraud-graph]]（AWS 圖檢測樣例）、[[fraud-detection]]（概念）配套；可解釋性方法與 [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] 同屬可信 AI 方向。
